# Pull Request

## Description | 描述

Please include a summary of the changes and which issue is fixed. Please also include relevant motivation and context.

请包含改动的摘要以及修复了哪个 issue。请同时包含相关的动机和上下文。

Fixes # (issue)

## Type of Change | 变更类型

Please delete options that are not relevant.

请删除不相关的选项。

- [ ] Bug fix (漏洞修复)
- [ ] New feature (新功能)
- [ ] Breaking change (破坏性变更)
- [ ] Documentation update (文档更新)
- [ ] Performance improvement (性能优化)
- [ ] Code refactoring (代码重构)

## Checklist | 检查清单

- [ ] My code follows the code style of this project | 我的代码符合项目的代码风格
- [ ] Backend: `go vet ./...` passes | 后端：go vet 通过
- [ ] Backend: `go test -race ./...` passes | 后端：测试通过
- [ ] Frontend: `npx tsc --noEmit` passes | 前端：TypeScript 检查通过
- [ ] Frontend: `npx eslint src/` passes | 前端：ESLint 检查通过
- [ ] I have added tests that prove my fix is effective or that my feature works | 我添加了测试
- [ ] I have updated the documentation accordingly | 我已更新文档
- [ ] My changes generate no new warnings | 我的改动没有产生新的警告

## Screenshots | 截图

If applicable, add screenshots to help explain your changes.

如果适用，添加截图以帮助解释您的改动。

## Testing | 测试

Please describe the tests that you ran to verify your changes.

请描述您运行的测试以验证您的改动。
